input.query: SELECT month, reject_reason, sum(n_rejections) rejections, sum(n_rejections)::DOUBLE / sum(sum(n_rejections)) OVER (PARTITION BY month) rejection_share FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE platform='android' AND doc_type='national_id' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
